Multiple model providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama and OpenAI-compatible servers

Developers and teams who want to compose agent workflows visually and run them on their own infrastructure with multiple model providers or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. A Windows desktop build and 53 ready-to-run templates also make it usable by individuals.
out/isocline/index.html: A research workflow runs specialist agents in parallel, merges their outputs, and pauses for human approval before generating a report. The run inspector shows each node’s output, token usage, latency and estimated cost.
This is demonstrated functionality, not a customer deployment.
A demo run paused at the human-approval step.

Isocline is an open-source, self-hosted control plane for agent workflows. You compose a workflow on a canvas, run it with multiple model providers or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and the runtime keeps it correct through crashes, restarts, slow human approvals and failed side effects.
